During the [[Galactic War]], a dormant '''immense starship''' of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] design that disrupted [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] was discovered in a long-forgotten [[Valtava sector/Legends|Valtava sector]], within an [[asteroid field]] of billions of glowing red [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]]. Some of these crystals awoke with power when their bearer was in extreme danger.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=other|Item: "Crystal of Nightmare Fury"}}</ref>
